owner: Existing LayIbusEngine owned Space/reset receipt and paired exact replay scope; existing daemon exact-tail uinput executor
first_failed_transition: A live owned Space append expects U+0020; Firefox rich editing acknowledges U+00A0 with exact unchanged token and cursor. Existing reset rereceipt rejects surrounding_receipt_mismatch and ManualToggleV3 returns context_authority.
decision: Acknowledge only the raw U+00A0 surface of one proved owned Space append. Retain raw snapshots, same epoch and paired local/shared tail. The existing exact-source native replay supports that single already-acknowledged separator using its unchanged ASCII Space key. A completed replay may acknowledge U+00A0 only with full matching external prefix, complete observed key progress and live source/reset provenance; update both existing scope copies atomically before the unchanged exact validator and reducer alignment. A replay-closing Space may carry an independently proved boundary token instead of a replay seed; use the same completed scope as its effect witness without replacing the receipt token or its existing reducer path.
preconditions: First post-append observation only; no selection; exact token and left/right word bounds
Live matching owner/scope/token; revoked predecessor; unchanged tail epoch and complete observed suffix
Only one trailing U+0020 may be acknowledged as U+00A0; no other Unicode normalization
No active composition/atomic edit, sensitive field or pending edit postcondition; replay remains quarantined except for acknowledgment of its fully completed, identity-bound scope
No new authority on adoption alone; existing exact receipt confirmation and verifier still decide

Completed replay acknowledgment requires both equal local/shared scopes, raw full prefix+replacement snapshot, exact end cursor, live expiry and authenticated source provenance; no partial replay adoption

alternatives.solution: Bounded acceptance acknowledgment in existing observation owner
Separate word and raw separator storage throughout the tail contracts
Fix client behavior upstream in Firefox

daemon.scope: Daemon production source unchanged since this gate; final test helper changes are IME-only.

native_changed_bytes.scope: Native evdev/AT-SPI in normal fields1/7/8/10 only; current acknowledgment fixes the raw boundary, while append/Backspace authority and plain-field rapid replay remain failing. Kernel release time and panel icon unmeasured; no laptop Snap/human hardware parity.

review_pass_1.blocking_finding: New raw NBSP tail delegates but preflight rejects its source separator; completed replay also needs the raw acknowledgment. Added production preflight and completed-replay/second-toggle regressions.

review_pass_2.scope: Read-only production/source proof review before final root-owned completed-boundary witness selection; full native and C09/C10 remain unproved.

proof.post_review_root_change: The complete-boundary regression showed a freshly owned closing-Space token without a carried replay seed. The same live completed scope is now used only for raw acknowledgment; original receipt provenance is retained. The final 711-test gate covers this branch and negative cases.
